steps.code:
# Parse all habit notes into structured data
import re

habit_data_parsed = []
for note in habit_data:
    # Extract date from title
    m = re.search(r'(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})', note['title'])
    if not m:
        print(f"Warning: no date in title for note {note['note_id']}")
        continue
    date = m.group(1)
    
    # Parse content lines
    lines = note['content'].split('\n')
    # Skip header line and empty lines
    habits = {}
    for line in lines:
        line = line.strip()
        if not line or line.startswith('#'):
            continue
        if ':' in line:
            habit, value = line.split(':', 1)
            habits[habit.strip()] = value.strip()
    habit_data_parsed.append({'date': date, 'habits': habits})

# Check all notes have same habit keys in same order
first_habits = list(habit_data_parsed[0]['habits'].keys())
print("Habit order from first note:", first_habits)
all_same = all(list(d['habits'].keys()) == first_habits for d in habit_data_parsed)
print("All notes have same habit order:", all_same)
print(f"Total parsed notes: {len(habit_data_parsed)}")
